name: Thundara
doc: Thundara (the spell): the root - every 15 ticks the bolt of the next action on its first target: twenty sparks around the target thrown outwards, a full-screen flash, the strike's sprite layers and three prim models, flash sprites around the target, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag102_thundara.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Bolt
parts.doc: One bolt an action on its first target: the sparks thrown outwards, the screen flash, the strike's sprite layers and prim models, the flash sprites, the sound; the damage

params.label: Damage frame
params.doc: The damage at this frame of the bolt
